what: WEC Energy Group is a regulated utility serving Wisconsin, Illinois, Michigan and Minnesota. It delivers electricity and natural gas to around 4.7 million customers and owns a share of American Transmission Company.
customers: Households, businesses and industrial users across four Midwestern states.
money: gas distribution in Illinois and neighbouring states
moat: Regulated monopolies in states where it has operated for over a century, with returns set by state commissions.
risks: Debt of about $21 billion against almost no cash
Wisconsin and Illinois regulators set the returns it may earn
Heavy capital spending requires continuous financing
Analyst targets imply the shares are already fully valued
opportunities: A large data centre development in Wisconsin raises long-term electricity demand
Operating margin of 23% with a dividend raised for two decades
watch: Data centre load growth in Wisconsin and rate case outcomes.
